question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Tenacious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Yielding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Tenacious"** means someone or something that is very determined, persistent, or firm in holding onto something. (दृढ़/जिद्दी)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a tenacious negotiator who never gives up until she secures the best deal.
 
 
• The word **"Yielding"** refers to someone or something that is flexible, submissive, or willing to give way. (लचीला/आज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** He adopted a yielding attitude during the debate to avoid further conflict.
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Tenacious"** is **"Yielding"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **3) Yielding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Persistent** (लगातार/दृढ़): Someone who continues firmly or obstinately in a course of action despite difficulties.
 
 
• **Example:** His persistent efforts eventually led to success.
 
 

 
• **Fragile** (नाजुक): Something that is easily broken or damaged.
 
 
• **Example:** Handle the antique vase carefully; it's very fragile.
 
 

 
• **Firm** (दृढ़): Strong, steady, and unlikely to change.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a firm decision to pursue her dreams despite the challenges.
 
 

3c:Tb2d,

The correct answer is** option 4.**</p
